features.name: Discovery
features.purpose: Discover cinematic venue/rooms with photos, amenities, capacity and indicative prices
features.workflow: Browse catalog → inspect room → choose
features.acceptance: Usable catalog without auth; no fabricated availability or production sample price

features.name: Identity, profile and consent
features.purpose: Google sign-in, profile and secure session with explicit versioned policy acceptance
features.workflow: OIDC → server session → profile → consent record
features.rules: BR-08/10; auth does not equal consent/verification
features.acceptance: Owner-scoped session/profile; explicit policy version/time persisted

features.name: Availability and temporary holds
features.purpose: Choose room/date/time with conflict protection
features.workflow: Query slots → create expiring hold → checkout
features.acceptance: Two conflicting reservations cannot both commit; server expiresAt shown

features.name: Quotation and add-ons
features.purpose: Authoritative guest/duration/PS4 itemization
features.workflow: Choose guests/extras → server quote → accept version
features.acceptance: Base/PS4 examples correct; fifth guest charged once; final total server generated

features.name: Booker verification
features.purpose: NIC/passport upload, OCR assistance, age policy and manual exceptions
features.workflow: Consent → private upload → extract → validate/review → decide
features.acceptance: OCR cannot alone prove authenticity; restricted decision/evidence access

features.name: Hosted payment and confirmation
features.purpose: Hosted checkout, receipts and authoritative confirmation
features.workflow: Attempt → hosted provider → verified notification → reserve/confirm
features.acceptance: Redirect never grants success; duplicate events have one effect; receipt from ledger

features.name: Protected access and delivery
features.pages: Smart Door Access PIN; Booking Confirmation
features.purpose: Provisioning status, time-bound PIN and SMS/email access instructions
features.workflow: Confirm → install → acknowledge → deliver protected access → admit
features.acceptance: No access-ready state before install evidence; delivery failure yields support

features.name: Self-service booking history
features.purpose: Upcoming/past records, receipt and permitted changes
features.workflow: Owner list → detail → policy-checked modify/extend/cancel/refund
features.acceptance: No cross-customer reads; retain history and original terms

features.name: Referral and loyalty
features.pages: Loyalty and Referrals; Promotions and Loyalty
features.purpose: Proposed earning, expiry, redemption and referral rewards
features.workflow: Qualify → pending/earned → redeem/expire/reverse
features.acceptance: No invented earn rate; reversals audited; unavailable feature not promoted

features.name: Operational dashboard
features.purpose: KPIs, charts, live rooms, activity and system health
features.workflow: Select scope/range → authorized aggregates → drill-down
features.rules: Metric definitions; live vs physical occupancy separate
features.acceptance: All card labels include basis/asOf; no unavailable-to-zero fallback

features.name: Booking administration
features.purpose: Search/filter/page/detail/manual creation/change/cancel/extend
features.workflow: Find booking → permitted action → validate/quote → audited result
features.rules: BR-01–10; agreed revision and policy snapshots
features.acceptance: Stable paging; permissions checked server-side; no silent price rewriting

features.name: Venue and room configuration
features.purpose: Amenities/photos/hours/maintenance/enable/disable/device mapping
features.workflow: Configure version → impact review → effective update
features.acceptance: Existing reservation impacts shown; enabled does not mean clean/healthy

features.name: Equivalent room views
features.purpose: Card/table views of same rooms and permitted actions
features.workflow: Load scoped dataset → switch view
features.rules: One shared query, status map and permissions
features.acceptance: Both views return same IDs/states and preserve filters

features.name: Live control and incidents
features.purpose: Health, acknowledged controls, timers and incident handling
features.workflow: Inspect freshness → safe command → ack → observe/escalate
features.rules: Safety guards; no inference of empty room from exit/motion
features.acceptance: Requested != observed; no unsafe egress/power action

features.name: Account and verification review
features.purpose: Separate account/verification statuses and restricted evidence review
features.workflow: Find owner → permitted profile/review → reasoned decision
features.acceptance: Suspended != rejected; raw documents never in customer list

features.name: Finance operations
features.purpose: Transactions, fees, refunds, reconciliation and scoped exports
features.workflow: Ledger → eligibility → refund/reconcile → verified result
features.rules: Booked refund snapshot; ledger event dedupe
features.acceptance: Refund balance enforced; reconciliation discoverable; no card-data collection

features.name: Analytics and exports
features.purpose: Reports and financial/nonfinancial chart drill-down
features.workflow: Scope/query → definitions → aggregate → export
features.failureStates: Partial data; mixed currency; undefined recognition
features.acceptance: Export matches visible filters and metric IDs; separate scales

features.name: Engagement administration
features.purpose: Promotions, loyalty/referrals and audited adjustments
features.workflow: Version draft → approve rules → publish → ledger reversal
features.acceptance: Versioned eligibility; no retroactive rule changes to earned rewards without approved process

features.name: Policy and notification settings
features.purpose: Versioned pricing/policies/templates/integration settings
features.workflow: Draft → review impact → effective version
features.failureStates: Concurrent update; invalid provider; failed test
features.acceptance: Prior purchases/consent retained; no privilege escalation

features.name: Audit visibility
features.purpose: Scoped immutable operational evidence
features.workflow: Filter → redacted event detail → export
features.rules: No credentials/raw ID/card data; retention OD-05
features.acceptance: Actor/resource/reason/correlation recorded; no edit/delete UX

features.name: Access credential lifecycle
features.pages: Smart Door Access PIN; Room Live Control
features.purpose: Install/activate/expire/revoke and supported re-entry
features.workflow: Confirmed purchase → credential version → device ack → timed entry
features.failureStates: Offline install/revoke; clock drift; lock failure
features.acceptance: Valid only session interval; re-entry tested, not presumed

features.name: ESP32 and room automation
features.pages: Room Live Control; IoT Device Management
features.purpose: MQTT lighting scenes, AC and supported projector control
features.workflow: Register device → capability map → authorized command → ack/telemetry
features.rules: TLS; bounded setpoints; safety circuits excluded
features.failureStates: Firmware mismatch; stale telemetry; command expiry
features.acceptance: Only capability-supported operations; per-device auth and expiring commands

features.name: End-of-session operations
features.purpose: Five-minute warning, checkout/exit recording, cleaning and overstay escalation
features.workflow: Warn → session ends → safe expiry → cleaning task → staff clearance
features.rules: BR-06/09; exit event != all persons exited
features.failureStates: Missed warning; no cleaner; suspected overstay
features.acceptance: No physical-cleaning claim from timer; accountable intervention path

features.name: Connectivity and emergency recovery
features.pages: IoT Device Management; Room Live Control
features.purpose: Monitoring, tested offline entry, bounded retries/recovery and intervention
features.workflow: Detect stale → safe degraded state → reconcile → tested fallback
features.rules: OD-02/04; cloud unlock is not offline access
features.acceptance: Unknown not OFF/empty; independent egress and trained response verified before launch

features.name: Admin-editable package details duration and prices
features.purpose: Authorized administrators can modify package details, session duration, and prices through the Admin Panel, without editing application code or requiring a deployment for each configuration change.
features.actors: Authorized package administrator; publisher/reviewer roles proposed
features.workflow: Edit core package settings via Admin Panel; supporting draft/preview/versioned publish/schedule/deactivate/archive flow RECOMMENDED
features.rules: Canonical package specification; separate operational minimum, physical capacity and cleaning; immutable sold terms and accepted quotes
features.permissions: Proposed package.read/edit/publish/deactivate/archive independently within authorized venue scope
features.module: Pricing (existing proposed owner); Booking owns purchased snapshots
features.pages: System Settings → Packages & Pricing (proposed subsection, no verified route); customer package/quote/confirmation views
features.integrations: Venues/Rooms constraints; Identity & Access; Booking; Payments; Audit; no device command from catalog edit
features.failureStates: Invalid fields/constraints; denied scope; stale draft; overlapping versions; expired quote/hold; partial amendment outcome
features.acceptance: PK-AC01–13 in canonical package specification; no code/deploy per authorized edit, sold/valid-quote protections

features.name: Bank deposit transfer and receipt claim
features.pages: Payment Processing; Customer Dashboard/Booking History; protected claim upload/status
features.purpose: Customer bank deposit/transfer and receipt submission with confirmation after authorized independent verification; retain online gateway option
features.workflow: Accepted quote/request and provisional hold → evidence claim → admin review → verified funds/allocation → eligible confirmation → access workflow
features.rules: PR-BANK-001; receipt not verified; verified not confirmed/access-ready; method policy/fee/deadline open; purchased terms retained
features.permissions: Own bank request/claim read/submit; restricted review/verify/allocate; server venue/owner scope
features.integrations: Manual receiving-bank record matching recommended; private receipt storage; no bank API support claimed
features.failureStates: Under/excess/wrong funds; unmatched/late claim; expired inventory; notification/access failure
features.acceptance: BP-AC01–13; independent bank credit and guarded one-booking result; not tests run

features.name: Bank payment review and reviewer notification
features.actors: Authorized reviewer/verifier/allocator; bank settings and refund staff separately authorized
features.purpose: Notify scoped admins of review-required bank claims and enable independent receiving-account verification/approval
features.workflow: Durable review queue/alert → inspect restricted evidence and actual bank record → record credit → guard allocation/booking or resolution
features.rules: Bank credit fact retained even if service unavailable; no duplicate allocation/booking; adjustment/refund separate audited evidence
features.permissions: bank.review/evidence.read/verify/allocate/resolve distinct from bank.account.manage and refund execute/approve
features.integrations: Manual statement matching recommended; existing gateway unchanged; durable outbox/access interfaces
features.failureStates: Concurrent reviewers; reused receipt/transaction; unmatched bank credit; overdue review; suspicious correction; failed alerts
features.acceptance: BP-AC01–13; alert failure retains queue; approval alone no completed booking/access/refund
